entries.title: John 10:1
segments: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who does not enter into the sheepfold by the door, but going up by another way, that one is a thief and a robber.

entries.title: John 10:2
segments: But he who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:3
segments: The doorkeeper opens to him, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls [his] own sheep by name and leads them out.

entries.title: John 10:4
segments: And when he puts forth his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him. For they know his voice.

entries.title: John 10:5
segments: And they will not follow a stranger, but will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers.

entries.title: John 10:6
segments: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they did not understand what it was which He spoke to them.

entries.title: John 10:7
segments: Then Jesus said to them again, Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:8
segments: All who came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.

entries.title: John 10:9
segments: I am the door. If anyone enters in by Me, he shall be saved and shall go in and out and find pasture.

entries.title: John 10:10
segments: The thief does not come except to steal and to kill and to destroy. I have come so that they might have life, and that they might have [it] more abundantly.

entries.title: John 10:11
segments: I am the Good Shepherd. The Good Shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:12
segments: But he who is a hireling and not the shepherd, who does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and runs away. And the wolf catches them and scatters the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:13
segments: The hireling flees, because he is a hireling and does not care for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:14
segments: I am the Good Shepherd, and I know those that [are] Mine, and I am known by those who are Mine.

entries.title: John 10:15
segments: Even as the Father knows Me, I also know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:16
segments: And I have other sheep who are not of this fold. I must also lead those, and they shall hear My voice, and there shall be one flock, one Shepherd.

entries.title: John 10:17
segments: Therefore My Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I might take it again.

entries.title: John 10:18
segments: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down from Myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. I have received this commandment from My Father.

entries.title: John 10:19
segments: Then a division occurred again among the Jews because of these words.

entries.title: John 10:20
segments: And many of them said, He has a demon and is insane. Why do you hear him?

entries.title: John 10:21
segments: Others said, These are not words of one who has been possessed by a demon. A demon is not able to open [the] eyes of blind ones.

entries.title: John 10:22
segments: And [the Feast] of Dedication took place at Jerusalem, and it was winter.

entries.title: John 10:23
segments: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's Porch.

entries.title: John 10:24
segments: Then the Jews encircled Him and said to Him, How long do you make us doubt? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.

entries.title: John 10:25
segments: Jesus answered them, I told you and you did not believe. The works that I do in My Father's name, they bear witness of Me.

entries.title: John 10:26
segments: But you did not believe because you are not of My sheep. As I said to you,

entries.title: John 10:27
segments: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.

entries.title: John 10:28
segments: And I give to them eternal life, and they shall never ever perish, and not anyone shall pluck them out of My hand.

entries.title: John 10:29
segments: My Father who gave [them] to me is greater than all, and no one is able to pluck [them] out of My Father's hand.

entries.title: John 10:30
segments: I and the Father are one!

entries.title: John 10:31
segments: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone Him.

entries.title: John 10:32
segments: Jesus answered them, I have shown you many good works from My Father; for which of these do you stone Me?

entries.title: John 10:33
segments: The Jews answered Him, saying, We do not stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, and because you, being a man, make yourself God.

entries.title: John 10:34
segments: Jesus answered them, Has it not written in your law, "I said, You are gods?"

entries.title: John 10:35
segments: If He called those gods with whom the Word of God was, and the Scripture cannot be broken,

entries.title: John 10:36
segments: do you say [of Him] whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world, You blaspheme, because I said, I am the Son of God?

entries.title: John 10:37
segments: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me.

entries.title: John 10:38
segments: But if I do, though you do not believe Me, believe the works so that you may know and believe that the Father [is] in Me, and I in Him.

entries.title: John 10:39
segments: Then they again sought to seize Him, but He went forth out of their hand.

entries.title: John 10:40
segments: And He went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John baptized at the first, and He stayed there.

entries.title: John 10:41
segments: And many came to Him and said, John indeed did no miracle, but all things that John said concerning this One were true.

entries.title: John 10:42
segments: And many believed on Him there.
